runtimeRequirement.notes: PowerShell 7.4 or newer and GitHub CLI are required for live observations.

derivedFrom.guidance: Record this template ID, version, source digest, and evidence-normalization version in every customized copy; recompute installed digests after edits.

cursor.replay: The cursor covers PR identity, head SHA, state, draft flag, merge state, review decision, and ordinally sorted checks. An unchanged cursor returns idle without advancing occurrence.
cursor.occurrence: Every committed changed observation increments state.occurrence. Event IDs include that value, so retries before commit retain an ID while a later recurrence receives a new ID.

semantics.terminal: Merged or closed PRs return terminal. If preflight declares terminal, or terminalization occurs after safe preflight but before the first attempt, the result is eventless terminal.
semantics.duplicates: Event IDs are deterministic from PR number, committed-state-derived occurrence, and normalized cursor. At-least-once retries before state commit repeat the same ID; recipients must deduplicate it.
semantics.changedIdle: A changed observation classified idle commits its new cursor and increments occurrence without emitting an event. That consumed occurrence prevents a later recurring event from reusing an older ID.

initialEmission.actionable: A naturally actionable attention, ready-to-merge, or completion condition emits on the first attempt even when emitInitialSnapshot is false.
initialEmission.synthetic: The synthetic github.pull-request.snapshot baseline emits only when emitInitialSnapshot is true. The pinned registration keeps it false and does not authorize the snapshot kind.

semantics.diagnostics: Identity, authentication, provider, and configuration failures return schema-valid degraded results and write a structured detectorDiagnostic JSON record to stderr only.

credentials.policy: Use the GitHub CLI credential store or allowlist GH_TOKEN. Never put a token in parameters, state, fixtures, or registrations.

scheduling.maxSafeDowntimeRationale: The template reads current PR state and can miss short-lived check, review, or mergeability transitions; three recommended intervals is the conservative recovery bound.
